'''Sectoso''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Carrick Station]], Sectoso also shared his knowledge of underworld trading with others.
